scope: Independent static review of the frozen weapon_fire_rpc decoder and its tests against retained static serializer evidence. No build/test/runtime or source modification.

questions: weapon_fire_rpc decode encode validate consumed bit cursor schema suffix budget transactional
BitReader read_bounded read_bit position rollback bounded tag bit order
graft.source_fallback: Graft located decoder and BitReader semantics. Exact source/test files were read directly to compare implementation and assertions.

retained_static_evidence.basis: Four targeted original parameter records from two zlib blocks; original Engine.upk and HawkenGame.upk before/after hashes in record agree.
Corrected property-record offsets/flags/Enum and explicit caveat that UFunction parameter traversal order is a caller premise, not proven by the property Next chain.
Confirms retained HawkenGame export parser selection; does not add runtime wire evidence.

retained_static_evidence.relevant_anchor: Retained Byte serializer: null Enum uses 8 logical bits.
Eligible Bool uses one data bit without non-Bool presence.

implementation: Schema validation rejects zero bound/budget; caller-premise flags false; out-of-range IDs; and collisions among configured IDs before reading input.

Decoder works on a copied BitReader and commits the caller reader only after successful tag and argument parsing. Invalid tags, budget failures, and physical truncation therefore preserve the original cursor.

Budget accounting uses actual read_bounded tag width plus BYTE presence/data bits and the extended Bool bit. It checks post-tag usage before accepting; a successful result reports consumed_bits relative to the starting cursor.

BYTE absence maps to zero; present BYTE reads eight LSB-first bits. Extended stop adds one raw Bool bit with no second presence flag. The optional extended field ID means schema-selected meanings; a secondary schema with no extended ID rejects tag 32 as unknown.
The decoder returns after exactly one known RPC prefix and does not require end-of-input, so an unaligned opaque suffix is retained for the next protocol layer.
static_contract: Retained Engine records: ServerStartFire FireModeNum export 31981 and ServerStopFire FireModeNum export 31987; both ByteProperty, ArrayDim 1, flags 0x80, Enum FPackageIndex 0.

Retained HawkenGame extended-stop records: FireModeNum export 43617 ByteProperty (ArrayDim 1, flags 0x80, Enum 0) and bRecentFire export 43616 BoolProperty (ArrayDim 1, flags 0x80). The property Next link 43617 -> 43616 is not treated as proof of wire traversal order.

Static serializer evidence supports a conditional non-Bool presence bit and 8 logical Byte data bits for null Enum, plus one Bool data bit without non-Bool presence. The decoder requires caller assertions for primary PackageMap, correct weapon cache, correct parameter order, and all parameter eligibility.

The extended decode order BYTE then Bool matches the retained UC signature premise, but parameter-order proof remains external and is represented by schema.parameter_order_correct; no packet invocation/cursor was observed.
tests: Eight doctest cases cover independent literal frames, all 256 BYTE values, Bool false/true, unaligned prefixes, opaque suffixes, caller schemas and secondary-tag distinction, schema/tag rejection, per-prefix bit budgets, physical truncation and rollback.
Fixtures use a test-local bit copier and literal byte arrays rather than a production encoder. Source inspection only; tests were not executed under this review.

cautions: The bool fields in Schema are trusted caller premises, not facts verified by this decoder. Integration must continue to derive them from the relevant PackageMap/cache/eligibility and order evidence.
The decoder does not establish effective field-ID selection, live sender/receiver invocation, handler semantics, fire-mode policy, authority, gameplay, or transport acceptance.

The generated test fixtures cover budget exhaustion with complete literals and physical truncation separately; precedence when an input is both over-budget and physically truncated is not specified or tested. The implementation remains transactional and rejects both conditions, but error-code precedence for that overlap is unverified.

verification.conclusion: No concrete decoder defect found in this static review. This is a bounded code/contract review, not build validation or runtime/gameplay acceptance.
